what: One prompt as Copilot delivers it to both hook channels in the same run: its own userPromptSubmitted hook (COPILOT_HOME/hooks) and the Claude UserPromptSubmit hook in .claude/settings.local.json, which Copilot also runs.
method: tests/host-probes/host-payload-capture-probe.ps1 -Hosts copilot: the real host CLI, headless (copilot -p), in a scratch folder outside any repository, with scratch COPILOT_HOME; a capture hook copied raw stdin bytes. Environment values are not recorded. The real user hook files were verified byte-unchanged.
redaction: The user name in every profile path is replaced with probe-user (tests/host-probes/probe-fixture-redaction.ps1). sha256 is the captured bytes; fixture_sha256 is the file.
finding: Both firings carry the same session id, the same prompt text and the same instant to the millisecond (native timestamp 1793629006802 epoch ms; Claude-hook timestamp 2026-11-02T14:16:46.802Z). The hooks themselves ran 727 ms apart (hook_ran_utc).
